qualifier: UV and visible-light response, without pigment synthesis
name: MITF-M melanocyte regulation and UV light response
rationale: Members are MITF-M target-gene programmes, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation and cellular UV/light responses; unlike its confusables it carries UV-B/Hallmark UV response and lacks melanin synthesis, melanosome and keratinocyte members.

qualifier: spindle midzone and actomyosin contractile ring
name: Cytokinesis via spindle midzone and actomyosin contractile ring
rationale: All members concern cleavage-stage cytokinesis (midzone assembly, spindle elongation, Rho-driven contractile and septin rings, furrow formation), distinguishing it from spindle-checkpoint themes and from ESCRT-mediated abscission.

qualifier: retrograde endosome-to-Golgi and lysosomal delivery
name: Trans-Golgi-endosome retrograde traffic and lysosomal delivery
rationale: Members cover TGN vesicle biogenesis, endosome-to-Golgi retrograde transport and Golgi-to-lysosome targeting, unlike confusables centred on COPI/intra-Golgi traffic or plasma-membrane recycling.

core: G protein regulation of cAMP and calcium second messengers
qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz signalling to cAMP and calcium
rationale: Members are GPCR control of adenylate cyclase/cAMP and PLC-IP3-calcium, centred on Gi/Gz alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of cyclase and secretion, whereas confusables emphasise PKA/PDE downstream events or cholinergic/purinergic receptors.

qualifier: APOBEC3G cytidine deamination restriction
name: HIV-1 early replication and APOBEC3G cytidine deamination restriction
rationale: Members span HIV-1 entry, uncoating, reverse transcription and integration together with APOBEC3G/Vif cytidine-deamination restriction, distinguishing it from ADAR A-to-I editing, retroelement silencing and somatic hypermutation themes.

core: T cell adhesion and activation signalling
qualifier: integrin activation and immunological synapse
name: Integrin-mediated T cell adhesion and immunological synapse
rationale: Members concern lymphocyte integrin activation, cell-cell adhesion, raft/synapse assembly and T cell polarity signalling, in contrast to confusables on endothelial extravasation, Rho GTPase effectors, homing chemotaxis or dendritic cell activation.

qualifier: sensorimotor gating, tactile and visual behaviour
name: Sensorimotor gating, tactile, visual and exploratory behaviour
rationale: Members are behavioural phenotypes (grooming, exploration, psychomotor, prepulse inhibition, touch, vision, social interaction) plus amygdala and MECP2-GABA regulation; prepulse inhibition, touch and vision set it apart from vocal-learning, neurotrophic and reproductive behaviour themes.

core: Type I interferon induction by nucleic-acid sensing
qualifier: endosomal TLR7/8/9 via IRF5/IRF7
name: Endosomal TLR7/8/9 signalling to IRF5/IRF7 type I interferon
rationale: Members describe TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signalling and IRF5/IRF7-driven IFN-alpha/beta production in activated dendritic cells, unlike confusables on TLR3/UNC93B1 defects, RIG-I/cGAS sensing or downstream interferon responses.

qualifier: taste, olfactory and pheromone receptors
name: Taste, olfactory and pheromone chemosensory perception
rationale: All members concern perception of taste modalities, odorants or pheromones via chemoreceptors, distinguishing it from acid-sensing ion-channel themes and nose/olfactory nerve development.

qualifier: restriction of retroviral and foreign nucleic acids
name: Cytosine deamination restricting retroviral and foreign DNA
rationale: The three members describe cytosine deamination used to clear foreign DNA and block reverse-transcribing viral replication, unlike confusables on HIV life cycle steps, DNA demethylation/alkylation repair or somatic hypermutation.

core: DNA polymerase synthesis in repair and replication
qualifier: PCNA-dependent excision repair and translesion synthesis
name: PCNA-dependent DNA synthesis in replication, excision repair and translesion
rationale: Members are polymerase-driven synthesis steps: replication initiation/elongation and polymerase switching, NER and long-patch BER gap filling and translesion bypass; it lacks the glycosylase, mismatch, alkylation and double-strand break repair content of its confusables.

qualifier: replicase frameshifting, protein E maturation and host translation shutoff
name: SARS-CoV protein translation, maturation and host translation shutoff
rationale: Members cover coronavirus replicase translation with frameshifting, protein E maturation and viral suppression of host translation, distinguishing it from themes on viral genome replication, capping and other viruses' RNA synthesis.

qualifier: early chondrogenesis from condensation
name: Regulation of early chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation
rationale: All members concern cartilage condensation, chondroblast differentiation and up/down regulation of chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation, unlike confusables on osteoblasts, hypertrophy and growth plate maturation.

qualifier: plasma membrane and Golgi PIPs with cytosolic inositol phosphates
name: Plasma membrane/Golgi phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate metabolism
rationale: Members describe PIP synthesis at the plasma membrane and Golgi and cytosolic IP3/IP4 to inositol interconversion, whereas confusables cover ER/endosomal PIP synthesis and lipid transfer.

qualifier: vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors
name: Sulfur and selenium metabolism with B6 and molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members span transsulfuration, cysteine and sulfide catabolism, selenium compound metabolism and the PLP and molybdenum cofactors these routes use, unlike confusables on BH4/phenylalanine, glutathione or carnitine/choline metabolism.

qualifier: RET/GDNF-family neurotrophic signalling
name: Locomotor and exploratory behaviour with RET neurotrophic signalling
rationale: Members are locomotor, exploratory, grooming, social and nonassociative learning behaviours plus RET, ATF and neurotrophic signalling, the neurotrophic and locomotor members distinguishing it from sensorimotor-gating and synaptic transmission themes.

qualifier: multivesicular body sorting and viral budding
name: ESCRT multivesicular body sorting and viral budding
rationale: Members concern ESCRT function in multivesicular body formation and HIV/viral budding, distinguishing it from ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing and abscission and from receptor endocytosis themes.

qualifier: receptor and G12/13-Rho signalling, without coagulation cascade
name: Platelet adhesion, activation and degranulation via GPCR-Rho signalling
rationale: Members cover VWF/collagen adhesion, GPVI, GPIb, PAR, TP and P2Y receptor signalling, Rap1/integrin and Rho signalling and degranulation, lacking the coagulation factor cascade of its confusables and the endothelial shear stress of C1.

qualifier: pheromone response and social/vocal learning
name: Social, mating, parental and vocal-learning behaviour
rationale: Members are intraspecies behaviours (aggression, mating, parental care, pheromone response, grooming, observational and vocal learning), distinguishing it from ethanol, exploratory/sensorimotor and sexual physiology themes.

qualifier: miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC and miRNA turnover
name: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis, RISC silencing and miRNA turnover
rationale: Members cover miRNA and siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly, miRNA-mediated repression and miRNA degradation, unlike confusables on target-specific translational control, pri/pre-miRNA processing regulation or lncRNA/splicing.

qualifier: downstream RSK/p38 output and phosphatase attenuation
name: Ras-MAPK regulation, downstream RSK/p38 output and phosphatase attenuation
rationale: Members concern positive and negative control of Ras-ERK signalling, RSK and RIT/RIN-p38 outputs and tyrosine dephosphorylation, whereas confusables centre on RAF activation and RAS/RAF/BRAF mutant signalling.

qualifier: branches to dolichol and lanosterol
name: Mevalonate isoprenoid synthesis toward dolichol and lanosterol
rationale: Members run from isopentenyl, farnesyl and geranylgeranyl diphosphate to dolichol/dolichyl phosphate and lanosterol, distinguishing it from post-lanosterol cholesterol, quinone/vitamin K and GPI anchor themes.

qualifier: netrin/DCC and L1-driven axon extension
name: Netrin/DCC and L1 signalling in axon extension and guidance
rationale: Members are netrin/DCC, L1, ROBO-ABL, ephrin and RAC1 guidance signals promoting axon extension, in contrast to confusables on ephrin-mediated repulsion, growth cone collapse, fasciculation and commissural pathfinding.

qualifier: reward, conditioning and locomotor behaviour
name: Dopamine receptor signalling in reward and locomotor behaviour
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor coupling to cyclase, PLC and arrestin, dopaminergic transmission and associated conditioning, locomotion and stimulant responses, unlike confusables centred on cocaine, ethanol, opioid or neuropeptide signalling.

qualifier: glutamate synthesis, catabolism and glutamine interconversion
name: Glutamate synthesis, catabolism and glutamine interconversion
rationale: All three members concern glutamate biosynthesis, catabolism and exchange with glutamine, distinguishing it from urea cycle/arginine and GABA metabolism themes.
